name: Control latency forensics
queries: Why are founder CEOs becoming harder for boards to remove?
notes: Forensics on the verified control only - no alternatives, nothing optimised. The arm is byte-identical to the replication: same Sonnet 5 model, same saved founder_ceos packet, same system prompt, same 220-token ceiling, same 25-word sentence-boundary rule, no thinking or output_config sent. Twenty trials so the segments have a usable spread. The instrumentation is observational: it records perf_counter checkpoints and reads response metadata that already exists, and a golden-request test asserts the request itself is unchanged. This run is the baseline every later generation experiment is compared against.
